data.text: Kate, I can take 7.5 tons this month if Emma agrees to her share too. My family’s fished this lake for years, and I want all five of us to make a living without putting next month’s catch at risk. I’d prefer 10 tons each for simplicity, but I’m open to Luke’s split if we settle the rotation first: over five months, each person gets two turns at 15, two at 7.5, and one at 5. That keeps everyone’s total equal and our combined monthly catch at 50. Emma, would you be comfortable with that, or would you rather split evenly?
